items.transcript: You already have all the ingredients to make the best mould spray you'll ever try. In a dark bottle, mix 1 cup hydrogen peroxide, 1 tablespoon of dish soap and 10 drops of clove or tea tree oil. This mix is powerful at getting rid of mould and also killing the spores that prevent it from returning. You can use it in your shower, on fabric and even your washing machine seals to keep tough mould away.

Save this video before you next have guests over 🌻 Britex has been helping Aussies tackle tough stains for over 40 years, so their everyday range is a must have in the home as we head into entertaining season. Which area surprised you the most? 🌻 
1. Old carpet spills can still smell if they haven’t been cleaned properly. Britex Spot n Stain is amazing for lifting tough stains, old and new, from deep inside carpet fibres.
2. Tough urine and vomit stains? Britex Urine Remover is a game changer. Its no-touch formula means you simply spray, cover and let it do the work, without heavy scrubbing.
3. Don’t forget your vacuum filter! It can hold onto smells, so make sure you wash it regularly to keep your vacuum fresh.
4. Couches, bedheads and mattresses can trap cooking and pet odours. Britex Odour Blaster helps eliminate odours from the source, rather than just masking them.
5. Add ½ cup citric acid and baking soda to your drain, then flush with hot water to help clean and deodorise.

Hope these were helpful lovelies xx @britexcarpetcare 

#tipsandtricks #hometips #cleaninghacks #mamamilastips #homefragrance

items.transcript: Here's the trick to remove tough sweat stains from your clothes. Just apply it straight to the stain and buff it in with a brush. Then wash as usual, and stains will disappear.

#6 is the trick to never lose a sock in laundry again 🧦 Save these 7 tricks before your next laundry day to make your clothes look and smell amazing for longer 🧺 which one will you be trying first? 
1. A musty washing machine will cause musty clothes, so make sure youre emptying your drain pump and filter regularly to clear stagnant water
2. Take off your detergent tray and clean it to remove hidden build up
3. When washing clothes make sure to fasten zips as they can damage other clothes in the spin cycle and cause fading
4. But leave buttons open as they can pull in the wash
5. You can also wash new dark clothes with 1 cup epsom salt to prevent fading
6. Wash and dry socks in a mesh laundry bag to never lose a sock in the laundry again
7. Use less detergent - 1 tbs is often all you need too much can leave a build up and makes clothes feel stiff

Hope these were helpful lovelies xx 

#laundrytips #tipsandtricks #mamamilastips #homehacks
items.transcript: Before you do your next load of laundry, try these seven tricks to make your clothes look and smell so much better. Fresh clothes start with a clean machine, so make sure your machine's drain pump is empty as all that stagnant water can cause musty smell. Then clean your detergent tray to remove hidden buildup. Always make sure to fasten zips, but leave buttons open as they can pull in the wash. And you can also wash in your darks with one cup of Epsom salt to prevent fading. Wash and dry your socks in a mesh laundry bag and you will never lose a sock in laundry again. And use less detergent. One tablespoon is often all you need. Too much can leave a buildup and make clothes feel stiff.

4. And you can use this mix on stovetop burners with steel wool to leave them sparkling
5. Heat a spoon in boiling water before measuring honey so it doesn’t stick to the spoon

Hope these were helpful lovelies xx
